mainEntity.name: What is the process for building a detached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for building a detached ADU involves several key steps. First, an initial consultation and feasibility study determine what's possible on your property. This is followed by architectural design and engineering plans. Next, plans are submitted to the local city planning department for permit approval. Once permits are issued, construction begins, including site preparation, foundation, framing, utilities, interior finishes, and exterior work. Finally, a city inspection and certificate of occupancy are issued.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design, permitting, construction (site prep, foundation, framing, utilities, finishes), and final inspections.
